tools.name: lianex_browse
tools.description: List published browse categories with their slug, display name and updated_at freshness. Use a slug with /api/public/browse/{slug} to retrieve its cached products. updated_at is null when no listing is cached. Cache-only.

tools.name: lianex_browse_by_slug
tools.description: Return ranked cached products for a published category. Unknown or unpublished slugs return 404. A renamed slug returns 200 with redirect_to; request that current slug. An empty category returns found: false, noindex: true and products: []. Otherwise found is true; total counts the products in this

tools.name: lianex_product_by_safe_id
tools.description: Return one cached product and any stored cross-marketplace offers. safe_id is the provider-qualified permalink ID, or a provider-less eBay ID. Unknown IDs return 404; removed public products return 410. Unavailable fields may be null. Each offer entry is one marketplace: its matched hits and last_ch

tools.name: lianex_products
tools.description: List published product permalink IDs and their updated_at freshness. Use the IDs to request individual products. Omitting limit returns the full published index; otherwise offset, page_size and has_more describe the page. ignored lists unusable paging parameters. Results can change between requests.

tools.name: lianex_search
tools.description: Search cached products using query words and, when recognized, their product category. Category matching can include titles that omit the category word; insufficient category evidence falls back to title matching. An explicit category filter replaces automatic category selection. Cache-only: no live

tools.name: lianex_resolve_compare
tools.description: Resolve up to 3 comma-separated product permalink IDs into cached listings for comparison. Each listing includes url, marketplace and item_id, plus title, price and condition when available. Unresolvable IDs and IDs beyond the limit are omitted; an empty set returns listings: []. Cache-only.

tools.name: lianex_vs
tools.description: List published comparisons whose products remain cached, ordered by slug, with updated_at freshness. Omitting limit returns the full published index. Otherwise use offset, page_size and has_more; ignored lists unusable paging parameters. Results may change between requests. Cache-only.

tools.name: lianex_vs_by_slug
tools.description: Return a published comparison with columns, rows, summary and product sides. Unknown, retired or suppressed slugs return 404; missing cached products return 410. A non-canonical product order returns 200 with redirect_to naming the canonical slug. Cache-only.

tools.name: lianex_share_comparison_by_snapshot_id
tools.description: Resolve a historical shared-comparison token to its canonical comparison slug. A successful response contains redirect_to and result: "redirect"; it does not return the historical comparison body. Unknown or retired tokens return 404. Cache-only.
